summary: Q2 Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K on July 29, 2026, reporting Q2 2026 results and announcing a $350 million additional share repurchase authorization. The buyback may be executed via open-market purchases, privately negotiated transactions, accelerated share repurchases, block trades, or Rule 10b5-1 plans. The authorization has no expiration and does not obligate repurchases; execution depends on market conditions. The company also released financial results: Q2 revenues of $219.8 million, up 13% year-over-year; GAAP net income of $29.9 million. No advisors or timeline were specified. Watch for repurchase pace and balance-sheet impact.
